mutants.description: Radar interference causing false target detection
mutants.failureScenario: High levels of radar interference create numerous ghost targets.
mutants.defenseSystemImpact: Overwhelms target processing, leading to system overload and potential misidentification of threats.

mutants.description: Sensor accuracy degradation due to temperature effects
mutants.failureScenario: High operating temperature causes range measurement error in the radar.
mutants.defenseSystemImpact: Inaccurate target positioning, impacting threat assessment and missile guidance.

mutants.description: Anti-jamming protocol failure during high interference
mutants.failureScenario: The anti-jamming frequency hopping fails to evade the jamming signal.
mutants.defenseSystemImpact: Radar becomes ineffective, leading to complete loss of target tracking.

mutants.description: Target classification error due to low RCS
mutants.failureScenario: Small RCS targets are misclassified as decoys instead of threats.
mutants.defenseSystemImpact: Failure to identify and respond to incoming threats.

mutants.description: Communication timeout between radar and tracking system
mutants.mutatedCode: await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5000)); // Simulate 5-second delay
mutants.failureScenario: A communication link failure creates a delay in data transfer between systems.
mutants.defenseSystemImpact: Delayed threat assessment and potential loss of situational awareness.

mutants.description: Power fluctuation affecting radar signal processing
mutants.failureScenario: Voltage drop causes a fluctuation in the signal detection threshold
mutants.defenseSystemImpact: Either increased false positives or missed target detections

mutants.description: System clock drift affecting target tracking accuracy
mutants.failureScenario: A significant clock drift introduces errors in the target's position calculation.
mutants.defenseSystemImpact: Inaccurate tracking and prediction of target trajectories.
